facts.text: Maria tried surfing for the first time during her vacation and found it exciting despite falling off repeatedly.

evidence.quote: I tried my hand at surfing for the first time- it was so exciting! Even though I kept falling off, it taught me the power of not giving up and trying new things.

facts.text: Maria learned the importance of valuing different perspectives and the power of solitude during her trip.

evidence.quote: I realized that it's important to value different perspectives and the power of solitude.

facts.text: John encouraged Maria to keep up the courage and emphasized the rewards of trying new things.

evidence.quote: Wow Maria, that's awesome! Trying new things takes guts and it can be so rewarding. Keep up the courage!

facts.text: Maria acknowledged the importance of challenging oneself and pushing out of comfort zones to experience new things and learn.

evidence.quote: We gotta push ourselves out of our comfort zones to experience new things and learn!
